whyNotVendored: This repository is a UI/UX prototype in React + Node + Tailwind with no .NET and no database (user decision). The 5.00.1 tree cannot build or run here, so the baseline is pinned as a reference and its screens, entities, setting keys and permission names are replicated/mapped in docs/platform/baseline-mapping.md.

fixedDecisions.CART-500: Single cart split across sellers; shoppingcartsettings.vendorenabled = false and .vendorrequired = false
fixedDecisions.PRICE-500: Native price lists for CAT-039/042; per-currency fixed prices built

prototypeStore: in-memory, behind an async IRepository-shaped interface (no database - P-4 deviation)
